content.text: {"id": "mm5810a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among contacts aged <15 years, 20 (33%) of 60 had latent TB infection."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "they accounted for more than half of the suspected and confirmed MDR TB cases since July 2008 (nine of 16)"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "16 (8%) of the 205 contacts identified have confirmed or suspected MDR TB disease"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The 2007 incidence rate (127 TB cases per 100,000) is 29 times higher than the 2007 U.S. rate"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "124 (60%) have latent TB infection"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Although fewer than one third of the contacts were aged <15 years (60 of 205)"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "outbreak investigation", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "This report describes the investigation by the World Health Organization (WHO) and CDC"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "A confirmed case was defined as laboratory-confirmed MDR TB disease in a Chuuk resident during January 2006--June 2008."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "A suspected case of MDR TB disease was defined as exposure (based on intensity and duration of contact) to a patient with confirmed TB"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Patients (or proxies for deceased patients) were interviewed and laboratory and medical records reviewed."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "a standardized clinical examination, chest radiography, and tuberculin skin testing were used to evaluate contacts"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
